## Run 52 — s1 Backend API Test — COMPLETE

**Result: Backend CONVERGED — 12th consecutive run, 0 code fixes.**

I ran the full standing probe suite against the running server (`:3001`, feat/financing branch). Every result is byte-identical to the Run 51 baseline:

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| sweep-all (245 routes) | 200×91 / 400×72 / 403×6 / 404×75 / 503×1 — **0 unintentional 5xx** |
| type-fuzz (1026 payloads) | 0 5xx / 0 err |
| tenant-isolation | 22/22 (tenant_id + X-Tenant-Id spoof ignored; non-platform-admin→403) |
| happy-write | 3/3 (PATCH lead/invoice→200) |
| edge + gaps | 0 5xx (sql-inj→empty, limits clamped→200, bad-uuid→400, wrong-method→404) |

The only non-200s are all **intentional**: skip-trace 503 (no `TRACERFY_API_KEY` — a paid API we correctly don't call), 6× 403 platform-admin-only, validation 400s, and missing-id 404s. No crashes, no 500s, error handling correct throughout.

**No code changes made** (charter: if it works, leave it alone → no fix, no commit).

**Deliverable:** `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt` written.

**Notes for next run:**
- Token gotcha persists — the DB-direct `.qa-mint-token.mjs` produces tokens the running server rejects (in-memory `JWT_SECRET` ≠ repo `.env`; operational env-state, not a bug). Mint via HTTP login instead and copy the token to repo-root `.qa-token.txt`.
- **Do NOT re-test the backend** — 12 runs converged. The remaining high-value gaps are all frontend and currently out-of-charter (Esc-to-close keyboard nav = enhancement; EstimateBuilder 375px sidebar = mobile paused, works fine at 768px+).
